name: Unraid-progressive-web-app
description: Open-source, self-hostable PWA to monitor and control Unraid via its GraphQL API. Default URL: http:// :[PORT:2442]

ports.name: WebUI Port
ports.description: Host port for the Unraid-PWA web interface.

variables.name: UNRAID_BFF_ALLOW_SELF_SIGNED
variables.description: Allow self-signed certs for Unraid server connections (true/false).

variables.name: UNRAID_BFF_TRUST_PROXY
variables.description: Set true if you run behind a reverse proxy (or specific proxy mode if supported).

variables.name: UNRAID_BFF_ORIGIN
variables.description: CORS allowlist. Usually leave default when accessing via http://UNRAID-IP:2442.

variables.name: UNRAID_BFF_ENCRYPTION_KEY
variables.description: Optional override. If empty, the app generates /app/data/encryption.key.
